purpose: Hypothesis-only set of Excel template patterns for research and promotion review.

patterns.title: Invoice line-item billing
patterns.why: A customer-facing billing sheet must turn detail lines into a printable invoice with totals and controlled inputs.

patterns.title: Monthly budget control
patterns.why: Budget sheets compare plan, actual, and variance by month so owners can correct overruns and track control against target.

patterns.title: Project timeline tracker
patterns.why: Project timeline sheets sequence dated tasks, milestones, dependencies, and owners; broad rollup dashboards are a separate pattern.

patterns.title: Matrix attendance register
patterns.why: Matrix attendance sheets keep a locked roster cross-tab with one row per person and one column per day or session, with protected total cells, per-date formula cascades, and roll-forward copies across periods. New students, new rows, and new periods must grow the matrix while preserving the locked roster structure and protected summaries; append-only check-in logs stay excluded.

patterns.title: Inventory movement and reconciliation log
patterns.why: Inventory movement logs record receipts, issues, transfers, and adjustments as transaction rows that can be reconciled back to stock counts and balances.

patterns.title: Expense reimbursement form
patterns.why: Expense reimbursement forms collect claim lines, receipts, approvers, and payout totals for submission.

patterns.title: Service ticket queue
patterns.why: Queue-first support workbooks track ticket state, owner, and priority in a row-based backlog with escalation visibility; request-intake forms are a separate pattern.

patterns.title: Scheduled maintenance log
patterns.why: Facilities sheets track planned inspections and service visits with completion notes, separate from incident-and-repair handling.

patterns.title: Health metrics tracker
patterns.why: Threshold-aware health trackers combine repeated measurements with explicit targets or ranges, protected summaries or locked flags, and durable trend or period review. Verifier-ready evidence must show the same measurement-control loop end to end; diary, regimen, archive, and planning variants split away unless they directly support that loop.

patterns.title: Loan repayment calculator
patterns.why: Calculation-heavy templates drive schedule outputs from a small set of controlled loan inputs.

patterns.title: Project status dashboard
patterns.why: Project status dashboards roll up detailed status rows into compact progress signals, without sequencing dated tasks.

patterns.title: Purchase order control
patterns.why: Purchase order control sheets manage request, approval, PO issuance, and receipt/invoice handoff checkpoints; procurement reconciliation is the separate pattern that matches requisitions, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices.

patterns.title: Asset lifecycle register
patterns.why: Assets move through acquisition, use, maintenance, and retirement with stable IDs and review dates.

patterns.title: Cash flow monitor
patterns.why: Cash flow monitors carry opening balance forward into inflows, outflows, and closing balance across repeating periods.

patterns.title: Sales pipeline tracker
patterns.why: Pipeline sheets track opportunities through stage, owner, and forecast totals.

patterns.title: Student gradebook
patterns.why: Gradebooks mix roster data, graded items, weighted formulas, and summary outputs.

patterns.title: Safety compliance register
patterns.why: Safety compliance sheets track risk and control state, open exceptions, and review dates rather than corrective work to closure.

patterns.title: Timesheet hours log
patterns.why: Timesheets repeatedly collect hours by person, date, and work code for payroll or billing, with period totals.

patterns.title: Procurement reconciliation sheet
patterns.why: Reconciliation sheets match requisitions, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices to isolate mismatches and missing links.

patterns.title: Warehouse reorder tracker
patterns.why: Warehouse reorder trackers maintain a snapshot of on-hand stock, reorder points, and replenishment flags rather than a movement ledger.

patterns.title: Training completion matrix
patterns.why: Training matrices map people against required modules or certifications in a dense cross-tab of completion status and due state.

patterns.title: Event planning runbook
patterns.why: Event runbooks coordinate schedules, owners, and task sequences for a fixed date; generic print-ready template logic is not part of the hypothesis boundary.

patterns.title: Client contact master
patterns.why: Master sheets centralize identities and related attributes for lookup by many downstream workbooks.

patterns.title: Quality inspection log
patterns.why: Inspection logs capture measured values, pass-fail decisions, and exception follow-up.

patterns.title: Vendor performance scorecard
patterns.why: Scorecards summarize delivery, quality, and service outcomes for supplier review.

patterns.title: Insurance claim tracker
patterns.why: Claims tracking needs status progression, document control, and time-based follow-up.

patterns.title: Research data log
patterns.why: Research logs need controlled entries, repeatable structure, and easy rollups for review.

patterns.title: Construction cost tracker
patterns.why: Active construction cost sheets track committed spend, approved change orders, forecast-to-complete, and phase-by-phase cost rollups; estimate sheets, bid comparisons, and generic project budgets are separate hypotheses.

patterns.title: Shift roster planner
patterns.why: Roster templates assign people to shifts while enforcing coverage targets, availability, and rotation or rest constraints.

patterns.title: Expense policy checker
patterns.why: Spreadsheet-native policy checkers only count when the sheet itself enforces category limits, receipt requirements, and approval thresholds with formulas, validations, and locked rule cells. Reimbursement routing, approval prose, printable claim forms, and other downstream artifacts stay outside the pattern; if no in-sheet rule gate appears, keep the pattern retired rather than widened.

patterns.title: Fleet dispatch board
patterns.why: Dispatch boards coordinate vehicles, routes, availability, and delivery timing.

patterns.title: Compliance action register
patterns.why: Action registers track findings, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and closure evidence until issues are closed.

patterns.title: Lab sample tracker
patterns.why: Sample trackers manage identifiers, collection timing, status, and measurement results.

patterns.title: Membership renewal monitor
patterns.why: Renewal sheets track expirations, notices, and recurring follow-up cycles.

patterns.title: Donation campaign tracker
patterns.why: Campaign sheets capture donors, pledges, receipts, and summary progress against goals.

patterns.title: Subscription renewal ledger
patterns.why: Renewal ledgers track start dates, next charges, billing status, and recurring customer changes.
